records.description: ImproTrack is a focused habit tracker for daily routines, streaks, archive history, and progress insights across your dashboard, stats, and archive views.

records.name: Barber Studio - Try the haircut
records.tagline: An in-shop AI hairstyle preview for barbers and salons.
records.description: Public, bring-your-own-key demo of the Barber Studio AI hairstyle preview.Barbers sell a result the customer can't see in advance. Reference photos on phones, Pinterest boards, and Instagram screenshots make this worse, not better - they show *someone else's* face with the cut. The customer points at a photo, the barber nods, and both sides hope they meant the same thing.

records.name: QSO Director - Early Access
records.tagline: Amateur Radio Logging Software
records.description: QSO Director is an all-in-one amateur radio operating suite that unifies logging, rig control, DX tracking, and contesting in one modern app. Built for performance and simplicity, it replaces fragmented tools with a fast, cross-platform solution. Early Access includes a free trial and lifetime discounted pricing.

records.name: Homee 好家
records.tagline: Less guess, more yes — AI real estate made simple.
records.description: Homee 好家是台灣領先的AI找房推薦平台，提供智慧房價評估、客製化房源推薦、免費AI房產諮詢。首購族首選，一鍵篩選好房，讓買房更簡單！

records.name: CodexBridge
records.tagline: The mobile control center for Codex + Cursor
records.description: CodexBridge lets you run and monitor Codex and Cursor sessions from iOS/Android. Pair in one command + scan, view threads, send prompts, and approve file/command permissions remotely so your workflow keeps moving when you're away from desk.

records.name: Blackout Curtain Dubai
records.tagline: Custom Blackout Curtains in Dubai – Free Measurement
records.description: Get premium blackout curtains Dubai with free measurement & installation. Custom designs, thermal fabrics & fast 24-hour service. Book now!

records.name: GPT Image 2
records.tagline: Free GPT Image 2 generator
records.description: Use the free GPT Image 2 generator online to create AI images, posters, product shots, ads, avatars, and social graphics from simple prompts.

records.name: Life in Weeks
records.tagline: Visualize your life in weeks
records.description: Visualize your life in weeks & see how little time might be left. Adjust for sleep, work, screen time & time with your loved ones.

records.name: Tambola
records.tagline: Where every number connects players in real time.
records.description: Most online Tambola platforms struggle with cluttered UIs, poor readability, unreliable gameplay, and issues like game resets on refresh. We built a better alternative - a clean, intuitive web app that ensures smooth and seamless gameplay for everyone. With persistent state management, players can refresh or rejoin without losing progress. We’ve added customizable rules and claim options for hosts, a built-in rulebook for clarity, enhanced audio calling and real-time synchronization

records.name: Disciply
records.tagline: Build habits that actually stick
records.description: Transform your life one habit at a time with Disciply's gamified habit tracking. Earn XP, unlock badges, build streaks. Join thousands building lasting habits.

records.name: 0xArchive
records.tagline: Live & replayable market data API for Hyperliquid & Lighter
records.description: Replay Hyperliquid, HIP-3, and Lighter.xyz market history through REST, WebSocket, SDKs, and bulk export for backtesting, research, and trading systems.

records.name: TextStow
records.tagline: A local-first clipboard workspace for Mac
records.description: TextStow is a local-first clipboard workspace for macOS. It automatically saves clipboard history, lets you bookmark reusable text, images, and files, and includes built-in text tools for cleanup, formatting, and quick transformations. Designed for people who copy all day and want a faster, more private workflow on Mac.

records.name: GitBar
records.tagline: Every pull request, one menubar. GitHub, GitLab & Azure
records.description: GitBar is the macOS menubar app for pull requests. Connect GitHub, GitLab (cloud or self-hosted), and Azure DevOps across any number of accounts, and every PR you care about is one click away. See what's yours, what's waiting on your review, and what's happening across your team. Status badges show approved, draft, conflicts, and checks at a glance. A live PR count lives in your menubar. Built with React Native for macOS. Free on the Mac App Store.

records.name: StanceNote
records.tagline: Structured stock research for Claude Code and Codex
records.description: StanceNote is a stock analysis workflow for self-directed investors using Claude Code or Codex, with structured bull case, bear case, watchouts, and decision framing.

records.name: Culina Core
records.tagline: Manage readiness, team, supply, and stock in one app
records.description: Culina Core helps restaurant operators manage daily readiness, staff, supply orders, stock, compliance, and reporting from one system.

records.name: Furniture E com site
records.tagline: Furniture
records.description: Shop Chinioti wood furniture online at M Ilyas. Explore new furniture designs in Pakistan from the heart of the Chiniot furniture market. Trusted since 1995.
